name: lights-out
description: Shows the background tasks this session left running and how much memory is free. Stops only what it started.

warnAgeMinutes.title: Age warning (minutes)
warnAgeMinutes.description: Toast once when a background task has run this long.

warnFreePercent.title: Free memory warning (percent)
warnFreePercent.description: Toast once when free memory drops to this percent, and show the band.
